ust.method: Overnight = New York closes strictly before each Jakarta close (New York shuts at about 04:00–05:00 Jakarta). Hedged = INDOGB 10Y minus β × US 10Y, β the trailing 26-week weekly beta known at the time. All variants walk-forward, z-scores vs trailing 52 weeks, thresholds ±0.5, hit rates over the next 4 weeks. The 'Beta 3Y' slot carries the INDOGB 15Y.

src: Yahoo Finance: IDX Composite (^JKSE) and USD/IDR (IDR=X) daily closes; any USD/IDR close more than 1.5% from Bank Indonesia’s JISDOR fix is replaced by JISDOR. INDOGB 10Y: PHEI IGSYC (CNBC benchmark 10Y before the first stored PHEI day). US Treasury daily par yields (2Y, 10Y; home.treasury.gov). Weekly, last trading day of each week.

method.window: 4-week changes; z-scores vs trailing 52 weeks (min 26); thresholds ±0.5
components: USD/IDR 4-week % change (inverted: a weaker rupiah is bond-bearish)
INDOGB − UST 10Y spread vs its 26-week average (wide = cheap)

method.window: 20-day changes; z-scores vs trailing 260 sessions (min 130); spread vs its 130-day average; thresholds ±0.5; hit rates over the next 20 sessions; UST hedge β = trailing 130-day daily beta
components: INDOGB − UST 10Y spread vs its 130-day average (wide = cheap)

notes.headline: A hot US CPI lifts Treasuries 10bp and the rupiah slips to JISDOR 18,154, yet the 10Y INDOGB edges down to 7.67% after a Rp79.7tn auction book; the daily signal falls to −0.77 and the Oct 7 sell-off episode stays open at +52bp, almost none of it explained by Treasuries. Signal −0.77: bond sell-off
notes.now: Foreign money is still out of Indonesian stocks over the month: the JCI slipped 0.21% to 5,115.04 ahead of MSCI's review, with foreigners net selling Rp287bn in the morning session after three days of small net buying, and it is 15.75% down over 20 sessions and 44% below its one-year peak. Bonds tell a different story on the day: Tuesday's SUN auction drew Rp79.71tn of bids, Rp18.01tn of them foreign (DJPPR data; foreigners won Rp10.6tn, 30% of the award), although who bought in the secondary market is not published. The daily signal fell to −0.77 from −0.66 (Nov 10 restated from −0.64): the 10Y trend part (z +2.08, the 10Y up 58.2bp over 20 sessions) and the JCI part (z −1.67) are the bearish drivers, the rupiah part is mildly bearish (z +0.40, USD/IDR +1.43% over the window, JISDOR 18,154 today), and only the spread part is bond-bullish (z +1.05), weaker than yesterday because Treasuries sold off. INDOGBs pay 269bp over Treasuries, 28.6bp above the 130-day average and in the 92nd percentile of 52 weeks; that is a nominal pick-up before currency risk. Treasuries explain little of the trend: over four weeks the INDOGB 10Y is up 51.9bp while the US 10Y fell 12bp, and with a 26-week weekly beta of −0.23 only about +2.8bp is the Treasury-linked part and +49.1bp is residual, which is what the US move does not explain rather than proof of domestic selling or political risk. On the day the link failed outright: the US 10Y rose 10bp in New York on hot CPI, implying about +3.3bp for INDOGBs at the 1-year daily beta of 0.33, yet the 10Y fell 1.1bp; INDOGBs follow large US moves in the same direction about 73% of the time, so expect some catch-up if Treasuries hold near 5%. The sell-off episode that began Oct 7 is open after 18 sessions with the 10Y 52.0bp higher. On the daily build since June 2022 the signal scores a Sharpe of 0.75 outright and 0.87 hedged against Treasuries, but sell-off calls were right only 51% of the time over the next 20 sessions (rally calls 58%), and the average 10Y move after a sell-off call was −1.8bp; these are in-sample back-tests. Our read for the next 2–4 weeks: neutral on duration rather than short, because sell-off calls have had little edge and auction demand is strong; MSCI (Nov 12), the impeachment motion against the Vice President and BI on Nov 17–18 are the risks that could turn it into a real sell-off.
notes.flip: The daily signal is in sell-off below −0.5 and sits at −0.77. A return to neutral needs the 10Y trend to cool as the mid-October jump rolls out of the 20-session window, plus a JCI holding above 5,100 with the rupiah back near 18,050. A deeper sell-off would come from JISDOR above 18,200, a new JCI low below 4,900 or the 10Y above its 7.72% high. A move to bond rally (above +0.5) needs a JCI rebound and a firmer rupiah together, the pattern that started the April 2025 rally. The policy triggers are a BI-Rate hike that steadies the rupiah (bearish for the front end on the day, bullish for the trend after) or MSCI softening its Standalone proposal; the DPR's impeachment motion against the Vice President is the political trigger on the other side.
phases: JCI 6,500–7,250 while the 10Y rose from 6.2% to a 7.58% peak in October 2022 as global rates surged; stocks held up on the commodity boom.

JCI 6,630–7,380 and 10Y 6.19–7.21%. Stocks and bonds drifted without a clear link; on the weekly build the signal's calls lost money (Sharpe −0.3 from 2022 to August 2024), while the daily build did better over the same span.
JCI fell from 7,812 to 6,258 while the 10Y rose from 6.43% to 7.19%: stocks, rupiah and bonds sold off together, the pattern the signal is built for. Its record improves sharply from here.
JCI climbed from 6,262 to a record 9,075 on Jan 15, 2026, and the 10Y fell to 5.93% in October 2025 as foreign money returned and BI eased.

MSCI froze Indonesian index changes in January and on Oct 15 proposed Standalone status; BI hiked 100bp to 5.75% by June and now weighs more. JCI −44% from its peak to about 5,115, 10Y up to 7.67%: the second and deeper foreign exit, though foreigners still bought SBN in October and bid Rp18tn at the Nov 10 auction. The daily signal fell to −0.77 on Nov 11 as Vice President Gibran's possible resignation turned into an impeachment motion in the DPR.
notes.caveats: These are proxies, not reported fund flows: daily foreign SBN holdings (DJPPR) and equity flows (IDX) are not machine-readable for the dashboard, so the rupiah and the JCI stand in for foreign money, and any statement about who bought or sold is a hypothesis. USD/IDR is Yahoo's close, replaced by Bank Indonesia's JISDOR fix on any day it strays more than 1.5% (Yahoo printed ~17,480 from Nov 3, 2026 while JISDOR was ~18,100); the 20-session windows count stored sessions, so gaps in the data stretch them. Before Oct 29, 2026 the 10Y is CNBC's benchmark-bond yield rather than PHEI's IGSYC, with repeated stale prints removed. The daily back-test runs from June 2022 (958 sessions): the live signal makes 190bp outright (Sharpe 0.75) and 216bp hedged against Treasuries (Sharpe 0.87), against −40bp for always holding the 10Y; the weekly build scores 0.42 and 0.57. Variants that use the US 10Y trend score up to 0.73 outright and 0.78 hedged on the weekly build but were picked after the fact and are not live. In-sample, no trading costs; not a trading system.
